title: Croydon Lullaby
description: A nocturnal 2-step roller at 133 BPM built around a chopped, pitch-bent soulful vocal that drifts over deep sub bass and off-beat dub-organ stabs. Swung LinnDrum shuffle and ghost hats carry the groove while the vocal is sliced, re-sequenced and dub-delayed; the track evolves continuously from a hushed intro through a sub-heavy main into a delay-soaked outro.

setcpm(133/4)
arrange(

    s("useme").chop(8).slice(8, "0 ~ 2 3 ~ 4 6 7").speed("<1 1 0.5 1>").gain(0.78).lpf(1400).room(0.3).delay(".4:.166:.5"),
    s("hh*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.34).swingBy(0.18, 8).degradeBy(0.3).pan(sine.range(0.35,0.65)),
    note("c1 ~ <eb1 g1> ~").s("triangle").lpf(420).gain(0.7)

  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ sd [~ bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.92).swingBy(0.16, 8),

    note("<c1 ab0 eb1 g0>").s("sine").lpf(600).gain(0.7),

  )],

    s("bd ~ sd [bd bd]").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.96).swingBy(0.16, 8).every(16, x=>x.ply(2)),
